verdict.rationale: Postman is a cloud SaaS that stores user workspaces, collections, and history, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of retention settings, data-deletion controls, or account and data purge capabilities. Adjacent items such as Postman Vault, request history, and role permissions do not address retention or deletion. A community anecdote about workspace deletion also removing the trash bin is incidental and does not document a user-facing retention control.
